title.zh-TW: 美股晶片股回吐漲幅，費半重挫7.88%、輝達跌5.86%
title.en: US chip stocks give back gains: SOX sinks 7.88%, Nvidia falls 5.86%

summary.zh-TW: 美股24日漲跌互見：費城半導體指數跌7.88%至8,832.50點，輝達跌5.86%至155.38美元，回吐前一日約31%的漲幅；那斯達克跌1.48%、標普跌0.50%，道瓊則漲0.85%至50,018.70點。報導指AI成本、估值與監管疑慮，以及外電稱美方即將公布新關稅，加重科技股賣壓；CME FedWatch顯示12月升息機率約97%。
summary.en: US stocks were mixed on Nov. 24: the SOX fell 7.88% to 8,832.50 and Nvidia dropped 5.86% to US$155.38, reversing part of the prior day's roughly 31% jump. The Nasdaq lost 1.48% and the S&P 500 0.50%, while the Dow rose 0.85% to 50,018.70. Reports cited AI cost, valuation and regulatory worries plus expected new US tariffs; CME FedWatch put December hike odds near 97%.

impact.zh-TW: 前一日暴漲後的劇烈回檔顯示AI類股波動仍高；週三PCE通膨數據與升息預期可能左右台股電子權值股開盤表現。以上為市場推論。
impact.en: The sharp reversal after a record surge shows AI-stock volatility remains high; Wednesday's PCE inflation data and hike expectations may sway Taiwan's tech heavyweights at the open. Market inference.

title.zh-TW: Anthropic股價跌破83美元發行價，創辦人依規畫出售持股
title.en: Anthropic slips below its US$83 IPO price as founders' planned share sales disclosed

summary.zh-TW: TheStreet經Yahoo財經報導，Anthropic（ANT）24日早盤一度跌約13%至76美元，跌破83美元發行價，較首日收盤97.17美元下跌約22%。申報文件顯示，執行長Dario Amodei與總裁Daniela Amodei各於20日以發行價出售約2.8億美元股票。Canaccord給予買進、目標價135美元，Oppenheimer給予優於大盤、目標價150美元；公司仍未獲利。
summary.en: TheStreet via Yahoo Finance said Anthropic (ANT) fell about 13% to US$76 in early trading on Nov. 24, below its US$83 IPO price and about 22% under its US$97.17 first-day close. Filings show CEO Dario Amodei and President Daniela Amodei each sold about US$280 million of stock at the IPO price on Nov. 20. Canaccord began at Buy (US$135) and Oppenheimer at Outperform (US$150); it is unprofitable.

impact.zh-TW: 新上市AI公司股價快速回落，反映市場對AI估值與支出的疑慮；報導引述12月15日與1月5日各有最多3.03億股可解禁，可能增加賣壓。分析師營收預估僅為預估，非已實現成果。
impact.en: The quick slide in a newly listed AI company reflects doubts over AI valuations and spending; up to 303 million shares each may unlock on Dec. 15 and Jan. 5, per Barron's as cited. Analyst revenue projections are forecasts, not results.

title.zh-TW: 台股大漲3,310點創史上最大漲點，台積電漲停
title.en: TAIEX jumps a record 3,310 points; TSMC locks limit-up

summary.zh-TW: 加權指數24日收40,122.35點，大漲3,310.46點、漲幅8.99%，創收盤最大漲點紀錄；上市櫃共621檔漲停，上市1,087檔上漲、31檔下跌。台積電開盤即漲停至2,230元並鎖住至收盤，電子類股漲9.49%、金融類股漲8.74%。成交值約4,194億元，報導稱為今年新低。
summary.en: The TAIEX closed at 40,122.35 on Nov. 24, up 3,310.46 points or 8.99%, a record one-day point gain. A combined 621 listed and OTC stocks hit limit-up; on the main board 1,087 rose and 31 fell. TSMC opened limit-up at NT$2,230 and stayed locked there. Electronics rose 9.49% and financials 8.74%. Turnover was about NT$419.4 billion, described as the year's lowest.

impact.zh-TW: 漲停鎖死使成交量偏低，買盤未完全成交；在美股晶片股隔夜重挫後，大漲後的獲利了結與波動風險升高。以上為市場推論。
impact.en: Locked limit-up prices kept turnover low, leaving buy orders unfilled; after the overnight US chip selloff, profit-taking and volatility risks following the rally are elevated. Market inference.

title.zh-TW: 川普再稱台灣拿走晶片產業，放話兩年後晶片關稅200%
title.en: Trump again says Taiwan took chip business, floats 200% chip tariff in two years

summary.zh-TW: Yahoo新聞轉載中天新聞報導，川普接受CNBC專訪時再度稱台灣拿走美國多數晶片生意，並表示兩年後台灣將支付200%晶片關稅，稱企業因關稅赴美設廠。他稱讚台積電董事長魏哲家，並稱台積電正在德州啟動另一座廠；路透文件顯示台積電子公司評估德州Brazos郡226億美元廠案，但尚未正式承諾。報導未說明200%關稅的法律依據或時程細節。
summary.en: Per a CTi report on Yahoo News, Trump told CNBC Taiwan took most US chip business and would pay a 200% chip tariff in two years, crediting tariffs for US plant building. He praised TSMC chair C.C. Wei and said TSMC is starting a Texas plant; Reuters documents show a TSMC unit weighing a US$22.6 billion fab in Brazos County, not yet committed. No legal basis or schedule for 200% was given.

impact.zh-TW: 200%僅為口頭表態，尚非正式政策，但可能加深市場對半導體關稅與在美擴產成本的疑慮；德州廠案仍屬評估中。以上為市場推論。
impact.en: The 200% figure is a verbal remark, not enacted policy, yet it may deepen concern over chip tariffs and the cost of US expansion; the Texas fab remains under evaluation. Market inference.

title.zh-TW: 美301產能過剩調查結果傳最快本週公布，台灣爭取15%
title.en: US Section 301 overcapacity findings may come this week; Taiwan seeks 15%

summary.zh-TW: 聯合新聞網報導，美國貿易代表署自3月起調查包括中國、台灣、歐盟、日韓、越南、印度在內16個經濟體的補貼與產能過剩，知情人士稱結果最快本週公布，但時程可能變動。消息稱已與美方簽協議者稅率可能在15%以下，中國、越南、印度可能較高；鋼鋁及汽車或排除。台灣官方力爭接近先前約定的15%不疊加稅率。以上多為匿名消息，尚未正式宣布。
summary.en: UDN reports USTR has probed subsidies and overcapacity in 16 economies, including China, Taiwan, the EU, Japan, South Korea, Vietnam and India, since March; sources say findings may come this week, though timing may change. Deal partners may face 15% or less, China, Vietnam and India more; steel, aluminum and autos may be excluded. Taiwan seeks near its 15% non-stacking rate. Unconfirmed.

impact.zh-TW: 最終稅率與涵蓋範圍未定，出口導向類股可能面臨不確定性；報導未提及半導體是否豁免。以上為市場推論，非已確定政策。
impact.en: Final rates and scope are undecided, adding uncertainty for export-oriented sectors; the report does not say whether semiconductors are exempt. Market inference, not settled policy.

reason.zh-TW: 報導指台積電24日漲停鎖至收盤；川普亦點名台積電並稱其在德州擴廠，美股晶片股隔夜重挫，三者皆與其直接相關。
reason.en: Reports say TSMC locked limit-up on Nov. 24; Trump named TSMC and said it is starting a Texas plant; the overnight US chip selloff also bears directly on it.

risk.zh-TW: 晶片關稅表態、德州廠案未定、美股半導體大幅回檔及升息預期。
risk.en: Chip-tariff rhetoric, an undecided Texas fab, sharp US semiconductor pullbacks and rate-hike expectations.

reason.zh-TW: 聯發科為台股大漲時報導點名的權值股之一；費半隔夜重挫7.88%，IC設計族群評價可能隨之波動。
reason.en: MediaTek was among heavyweights named in the record rally; with the SOX down 7.88% overnight, IC-design valuations may swing.

risk.zh-TW: 美股晶片股波動、AI估值修正及關稅不確定性。
risk.en: US chip volatility, AI valuation corrections and tariff uncertainty.

reason.zh-TW: 鴻海為大漲日報導點名個股；其AI伺服器業務與輝達股價波動相關，且出口業務可能受301產能過剩關稅影響（產業推論）。
reason.en: Hon Hai was named in the rally coverage; its AI server business tracks Nvidia sentiment, and exports may be exposed to Section 301 overcapacity tariffs (industry inference).

risk.zh-TW: 新關稅稅率與範圍未定、AI需求與估值疑慮。
risk.en: Undecided new tariff rates and scope; doubts over AI demand and valuations.

reason.zh-TW: 台達電為大漲日報導點名個股；AI資料中心電源需求情緒與美股AI類股走勢連動（產業推論）。
reason.en: Delta was named in the rally coverage; sentiment on AI data-center power demand moves with US AI stocks (industry inference).

risk.zh-TW: AI支出疑慮、大漲後獲利了結及關稅變數。
risk.en: AI spending doubts, profit-taking after the rally and tariff variables.

reason.zh-TW: 日月光投控為大漲日報導點名個股；晶片關稅表態與美股半導體回檔可能影響封測族群情緒（產業推論）。
reason.en: ASE was named in the rally coverage; chip-tariff remarks and the US semiconductor pullback may weigh on packaging sentiment (industry inference).

risk.zh-TW: 半導體關稅政策、終端需求與美股晶片股波動。
risk.en: Semiconductor tariff policy, end demand and US chip-stock volatility.
